title: Stable Failure Classification
description: Failure classes that propagate through research, handoff executor, feedback reviewer and development-system contracts.

classes.name: plan-mode-blocked
classes.description: Live research was attempted with permission mode plan, which cannot execute tools.

classes.name: unregistered-tool-requested
classes.description: Claude requested an MCP tool outside the approved registry.

classes.name: mcp-schema-absent
classes.description: MCP tool schema was not visible in the session.

classes.name: tool-count-zero
classes.description: No MCP tools were visible in the session.

classes.name: stale-session
classes.description: Session freshness was not proven; a stale session was detected.

classes.name: canary-missing
classes.description: Canary evidence was missing from the session.

classes.name: canary-failed
classes.description: Canary evidence was present but failed.

classes.name: permission-denials-nonzero
classes.description: Permission denials were nonzero in the session.

classes.name: output-not-json
classes.description: Research output was not pure UTF-8 JSON.

classes.name: source-mappings-invalid
classes.description: Source mappings in research output were invalid.

classes.name: unverified-sources-claimed-complete
classes.description: Unverified sources were claimed as complete evidence.

classes.name: format-retry-limit-exceeded
classes.description: Format repair retries exceeded the maximum of 3 without new retrieval.

classes.name: reinforcement-limit-exceeded
classes.description: Content reinforcement rounds exceeded the maximum of 1.

classes.name: claude-unavailable
classes.description: Claude was unavailable for the research session.

classes.name: timeout
classes.description: The research session timed out.

classes.name: internal-error
classes.description: An internal adapter error occurred.

classes.name: structured-output-empty
classes.description: The gateway returned no structured output when --json-schema was enabled; provider-native Schema enforcement is unavailable on this gateway/model combination.

classes.name: silent-native-downgrade
classes.description: Compatibility mode (adapter-validated) was activated silently after a provider-native failure instead of by an explicit profile selection.

classes.name: evidence-ledger-missing
classes.description: Serialization produced output without a frozen retrieval evidence ledger.

classes.name: evidence-hash-unstable
classes.description: The evidence hash changed between format attempts; serialization must use one unchanged evidence hash.

classes.name: unsupported-fact-introduced
classes.description: Serialization introduced a source, URL, claim, or claim-source mapping absent from the frozen evidence ledger.

classes.name: serialization-tool-access
classes.description: The serialization phase requested or used a retrieval, shell, browser, filesystem-write, or network tool.

classes.name: adapter-validation-failed
classes.description: Local Schema or semantic validation failed for an adapter-validated result that nevertheless claimed complete.

classes.name: format-attempt-exhaustion
classes.description: Three format attempts were exhausted without producing a valid output.
